evidence.note: Schofield notes that Epinomis was already attributed in antiquity to Plato's pupil Philip of Opus.
Jażdżewska treats Epinomis among the Thrasyllan dubia rather than genuine Platonic works.

rationale: Epinomis is traditionally attached to Laws but modern scholarship generally denies Platonic authorship; ancient testimony already associates it with Philip of Opus. It remains historically canonical, so C is the appropriate project grade.
